title: MOXIE: In-Situ Oxygen Production
quickFact: NASA Perseverance instrument that extracts breathable oxygen directly from Mars 95% CO2 air.
explore: The Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment (MOXIE) is a microwave-toaster-sized testbed aboard the Perseverance rover. It uses solid oxide electrolysis at 800°C to split carbon dioxide molecules (CO2) from the Martian atmosphere into carbon monoxide (CO) and breathable oxygen (O2), producing enough oxygen to keep an astronaut breathing for hours.

checkQuestion.question: What primary gas does MOXIE intake to create breathable oxygen?
checkQuestion.explanation: Mars atmosphere is 95.3% carbon dioxide. MOXIE strips one oxygen atom from CO2 molecules to generate pure O2.
